requirement: The signing keychain setup makes both of its passwords and puts the signing keychain first on the search list

oracle.ref: PR #1115 (fix); fix evidence: 10/10/2026 on the iMac: the first run wrote only tracy-signing-keychain.pass and exited 141 (tr SIGPIPE under pipefail) with no keychain and no .p12
oracle.invariant: S1: bash exits 0. S2: two different strings of 40 hex digits. S3: the list starts with the signing keychain (`LIST=("$KEYCHAIN")`) and is set with `security list-keychains -d user -s "${LIST[@]}"`.
